candidate.answerReason: In 300 seconds, Cagney frosts 15 cupcakes and Lacey frosts 10, giving 25 altogether.

methods.label: Add their individual outputs
methods.explanation:
Both people work for \(5\cdot60=300\) seconds. Dividing this time by the seconds needed per cupcake gives each person's output. Cagney frosts \(300\div20=15\) cupcakes, and Lacey frosts \(300\div30=10\) cupcakes. Their outputs add, so together they frost
\[
15+10=25
\]
cupcakes, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
methods.levelReason: Time conversion, whole-number division, and addition give a complete elementary solution.
